plain: A gift meant to win favor, like a bribe.

webster.text: A present or gift; a bribe.

example.quote: Will the feeble efforts of the house of representatives, in whom your security ought to subsist, consisting of about seventy-three, be able to hold the balance against them, when, from the fewness of the number in this house, the senate will have in their power to poison even a majority of that body by douceurs of office for themselves or friends.
example.cite: Cato, Letter V, New York Journal
